roads.description: Additional 23% operational costs for road renovations on top of the direct replacement costs.

sewerage.description: Renewal cost for gravity pipes is 975 EUR per meter. An additional 35% is added for operational costs. Sewer lifespans per soil type based on Micha's input (Zeer slap=30, Slap=40, Normaal=60).

optimization.description: All optimization parameters are tunable. Discount rate set to 3% as requested. Penalty coefficients can be calibrated once the municipality provides risk data.
